role: CI gate: log-call lines (debugLog, logger.*, os_log, NSLog, print, ...) must not interpolate PII/credential names, latitude/longitude, or raw RR/beat series.
toplevel: cd to repo root; sources preflight. SOURCE_ROOTS = args or Emuqu/Sources + watch app; a missing root -> exit 2. tmp via gate_mktemp (|| exit). Python writes one line per log call (LOG_CALL not preceded by a word character; the whole call found by string/interpolation-aware paren matching and joined onto one line) as file:line:call, skipping // lines and calls with `log-redaction-ok` on any of their lines or the line above; a Python failure -> exit 2. report() greps tmp for PII_PATTERN, GEO_PATTERN, RAW_SERIES_PATTERN (bare or member-path rr/rrValues/rrSeries/beats/rrIntervals, bare samples); any -> remediation text + exit 1; else clean with scanned count.

units.does: Greps the collected log-call lines in $tmp for an extended regex; on hits prints 'FAIL: <label> interpolated into a log statement' with the lines and sets global violations=1.
